description: Look up one US trademark by its 8-digit serial (application) number: mark text, current status and live flag, registration number, owners of record, attorney of record, filing/registration/publication/renewal dates, filing basis, international classes and goods/services, with data_as_of. Keyless. Optional api_key switches to USPTO's TSDR case-status record instead.

api_key.description: Optional USPTO TSDR API key (free at account.uspto.gov/api-manager). Omit for the keyless register record.

name: get_trademark_by_serial
